prompt: A contact form with fields for full name, email address, and a message. The submit button must stay disabled until all three are filled and the email contains an @. Submitting records the contact and shows a confirmation.
goal: Submit a contact for Dana Reyes at dana@example.com with the message 'Please call me back'.

prompt: An expense entry form with an amount field that only accepts positive numbers, a category picker (Travel, Meals, Software, Other), and a date. Invalid amounts show an inline error and block submission.
goal: Try to submit an expense of -40 first, then correct it to 40 in the Meals category and submit.

probes.why: the rejection must be perceivable, not silent

prompt: A change-password form with a new password field and a confirmation field. The two must match before the save button becomes usable, and a mismatch shows an inline message.
goal: Set the password to 'hunter2winter' by entering it in both fields and saving.

prompt: A feedback form with a required subject line and an optional comment. Submitting with an empty subject is blocked and marks the subject field as invalid.
goal: Submit feedback with the subject 'Slow export' and no comment.

prompt: A phone number entry form that strips spaces and dashes on submit and stores only digits. Numbers shorter than ten digits are rejected with an inline error.
goal: Enter the number '415-555-0142' and submit it.

prompt: A short-bio form with a 60 character limit, a live remaining-character counter, and an error state once the limit is passed. Submission is blocked while over the limit.
goal: Enter the bio 'Builds tools for small teams' and submit it.

prompt: A registration form with an age field restricted to whole numbers between 18 and 120. Out-of-range values show an inline error and block submission.
goal: Attempt to register with age 12, then correct it to 34 and submit with the name 'Priya'.

prompt: An invite form that checks the entered email against an existing member list of three addresses and refuses duplicates with a distinct message rather than a generic validation error.
goal: Attempt to invite the existing member 'sam@corp.com', observe the refusal, then invite 'new@corp.com' successfully.

probes.why: duplicate refusal must be distinguishable from format rejection

prompt: A shipping form with four required fields. Submitting an empty form reveals errors on all four at once rather than stopping at the first, and each error clears independently as its field is filled.
goal: Submit the empty form to surface all errors, then fill street '12 Main', city 'Pune', postcode '411001', country 'India' and submit.

prompt: A tag creation form that trims leading and trailing whitespace from the entered tag before storing it, and rejects a tag that is only whitespace.
goal: Create a tag by entering '  urgent  ' with the surrounding spaces.

prompt: A profile form with a required display name and an optional website field. Leaving the website blank must not block submission or produce an error.
goal: Save a profile with the display name 'Nikhil' and no website.

prompt: A booking enquiry form with a reset button that clears every field and dismisses any visible validation errors, returning the form to its initial state.
goal: Fill the name field with 'test', trigger a validation error by submitting without an email, then press reset.

probes.why: inverted check: errors should be gone; a host that leaves a stale error fails

prompt: A username picker that checks availability against a reserved list once the field loses focus, showing a pending state and then either a taken or available indicator. Submission is blocked while pending or taken.
goal: Try the reserved username 'admin', see it refused, then claim 'nkotari'.

prompt: A leave request form with a start date and an end date. The end date must not precede the start date; violating this shows a cross-field error attached to the end date rather than to either field alone.
goal: Enter a start of 2026-09-10 and an end of 2026-09-04 to surface the error, then correct the end date to 2026-09-14 and submit.

prompt: A list of five support tickets, each showing a title and a status. Tapping a ticket opens a detail view with the full description and a button to mark it resolved. Resolving returns to the list with the status updated.
goal: Open the ticket titled 'Printer offline' and mark it resolved.

prompt: An inventory list where each row has a quantity stepper. Changes persist when navigating into and back out of an item's detail screen.
goal: Increase the quantity of 'Blue widget' by exactly 3, then open its detail screen and return to the list.

criteria.note: stepper must not add or drop rows

prompt: A notes list of four notes. Each note's detail screen has a delete action that removes the note and navigates back to the list automatically.
goal: Open the note titled 'Grocery run' and delete it from its detail screen.

prompt: A projects list where the detail screen allows renaming the project. Saving the new name updates the row in the list immediately on return.
goal: Rename the project 'Untitled' to 'Q4 migration' from its detail screen.

prompt: An archive list that begins with two items. Removing both shows an explicit empty state with guidance text rather than a blank screen.
goal: Remove both archived items.

probes.why: a blank area and an empty state are indistinguishable to a screenshot judge

prompt: A reading list with an add button that opens a small entry screen. Adding appends the new item to the end of the list.
goal: Add a reading item titled 'Zhang and Shasha 1989'.

prompt: A prioritised task list of four tasks where each row offers a move-up action. Moving the top item up is a no-op and the control for it is disabled.
goal: Move the task 'Write tests' up by two positions.

prompt: A contacts list whose detail screen allows editing a phone number. Leaving the detail screen via back rather than save discards the edit and leaves the list unchanged.
goal: Open 'Ravi Menon', change the phone number to 9999999999, then leave using back without saving.

criteria.note: seed value; the edit must be discarded

prompt: A notifications list of six items, four unread. A single action marks every notification read at once and the unread count badge drops to zero.
goal: Mark all notifications as read.

prompt: A courses list where each course detail screen contains a list of lessons, and each lesson has its own detail screen with a completion toggle. Back navigation must return one level at a time.
goal: Open the course 'Systems', open its lesson 'Paging', mark it complete, then return all the way to the courses list.

prompt: A mail list of five messages where each row exposes a secondary archive action distinct from opening the message. Archiving removes the row from the inbox and increments an archived counter.
goal: Archive the message from 'billing@vendor.com' without opening it.

prompt: A shopping list showing a live item count in its header. Adding and removing items keeps the count accurate.
goal: Add an item called 'Rice', then remove the existing item 'Salt'.

criteria.note: seed is 3, one added one removed

prompt: A templates list where each row offers a duplicate action. The copy is inserted directly beneath the original with the suffix ' copy' appended to its name.
goal: Duplicate the template named 'Invoice'.

prompt: A table of twelve employees with name, department, and start date. Provide a department filter and the ability to sort by start date.
goal: Filter to the Engineering department and sort by start date so the earliest appears first.

prompt: A searchable list of countries with a free-text search box that filters as you type and a clear button that restores the full list.
goal: Search for 'ind', confirm the results narrow, then clear the search.

prompt: A table of eight orders with a status filter offering All, Pending, Shipped, and Cancelled. Selecting a status narrows the visible rows.
goal: Filter the orders down to only those that are Shipped.

prompt: A table of fifteen transactions supporting two filters at once: a type filter and a minimum amount. The two combine conjunctively and a summary line reports how many rows match.
goal: Filter to type Debit with a minimum amount of 100.

prompt: A sortable table of books where tapping a column header sorts by it, and tapping the same header again reverses the direction.
goal: Sort by title ascending, then tap the title header once more to reverse it to descending.

prompt: A filtered table with a 'clear all filters' control that resets every active filter and the sort at once, restoring the default view.
goal: Apply the Marketing department filter and a descending name sort, then clear everything with the single reset control.

prompt: A table of ten devices with a filter that can produce zero matches. When nothing matches, an explicit no-results message replaces the table body.
goal: Filter devices to the manufacturer 'Nonesuch', which matches nothing.

prompt: A paginated table of twenty-four records showing eight per page, with next and previous controls. The previous control is disabled on the first page and next is disabled on the last.
goal: Navigate to the third and final page of records.

prompt: A table where an applied filter must survive navigating into a row's detail screen and returning to the table.
goal: Filter to the Overdue status, open the first matching invoice, then return to the table.

prompt: A table of nine items with a toggle that hides rows marked inactive.
goal: Turn on the hide-inactive toggle.

prompt: A table supporting multi-select row checkboxes with a header checkbox that selects or clears every visible row at once.
goal: Select all visible rows using the header checkbox, then deselect the single row named 'Draft report'.

criteria.note: header checkbox must fall out of the all-selected state

prompt: A table where changing the active filter must reset pagination back to the first page rather than leaving the user on an out-of-range page.
goal: Move to page three, then apply the Active status filter.

prompt: A three-step account setup wizard: step one takes a username, step two a plan choice (Free, Pro, Team), step three a confirmation summary. Back navigation preserves entered values. Finish creates the account.
goal: Create an account for username 'nkotari' on the Pro plan, going back to step one once to verify the username was preserved.

probes.why: state preservation across back navigation is a classic host-divergent behaviour

prompt: A two-step booking flow: pick a date, then pick from available time slots for that date. Changing the date must invalidate a previously chosen slot.
goal: Select 2026-09-14, choose the 10:00 slot, then change the date to 2026-09-15 and confirm the slot selection was cleared before picking 14:00.

prompt: A two-step survey with a rating on step one and an optional comment on step two. A progress indicator shows which step is current.
goal: Give a rating of 4 and submit without leaving a comment.

prompt: A three-step wizard where the next control on each step stays disabled until that step's required field is filled.
goal: Complete all three steps, entering 'Acme' as company, 'Retail' as sector, and 25 as headcount.

prompt: A four-step onboarding wizard with a cancel control on every step that discards all progress and returns to the start with fields cleared.
goal: Fill steps one and two, then cancel from step three.

prompt: A conditional wizard where choosing 'Business' on step one inserts an extra tax details step that does not appear for the 'Personal' choice.
goal: Choose Business on step one, fill the tax id 'GST-4491' on the step that appears, and finish.

prompt: A checkout wizard whose final step shows a read-only summary of everything entered earlier, with an edit link that jumps back to the relevant step.
goal: Enter the shipping city 'Chennai', continue to the summary, use the edit link to change the city to 'Kochi', and complete the order.

prompt: A two-step import flow where step one selects a format and step two confirms. The finish button records the import.
goal: Import using the CSV format.

prompt: A three-step wizard that blocks navigating forward past a step with a validation error, keeping the user on the offending step with the error visible.
goal: On step two enter the invalid email 'nope', attempt to advance, then correct it to 'ok@corp.com' and finish.

prompt: A wizard that preserves a multi-select choice across back and forward navigation without dropping or duplicating selections.
goal: On step one select both Email and SMS as channels, advance to step two, go back, and confirm both remain selected before finishing.

prompt: A wizard whose finish control can only be pressed once; a second press must not create a duplicate record.
goal: Complete the two-step form for 'Meera' and press finish twice in succession.

prompt: A five-step wizard with a step indicator that allows jumping directly to any already-completed step but not to steps ahead of the current one.
goal: Advance to step four, then jump directly back to step two using the indicator.

prompt: A notification settings screen with a master 'Enable notifications' switch and three dependent switches (Email, Push, SMS) that become disabled and visually dimmed when the master is off.
goal: Turn the master switch on, enable Email and SMS but not Push, then turn the master off and back on.

probes.why: conditional enablement is where declarative-to-native lowering most often diverges

prompt: A display settings screen with a single dark mode switch that persists its state.
goal: Turn dark mode on.

prompt: A privacy screen with three independent switches and a save button. Changes are staged and only committed when save is pressed.
goal: Turn on analytics sharing and crash reports, leave location off, and save.

prompt: A settings screen where staged but unsaved changes trigger a confirmation dialog on attempting to leave, offering discard or stay.
goal: Toggle two settings, attempt to leave, then choose discard in the dialog.

criteria.note: seed value; the change was discarded

prompt: A sound settings screen with a mute switch that, when enabled, disables a volume slider and a ringtone picker beneath it.
goal: Enable mute, then confirm the volume control became unavailable.

prompt: A settings screen with a reset-to-defaults action guarded by a confirmation dialog. Confirming restores every setting to its shipped default.
goal: Change three settings away from their defaults, then reset to defaults and confirm.

prompt: An accessibility settings screen with a font scale picker offering Small, Default, Large, and Extra Large, plus a reduce-motion switch.
goal: Set the font scale to Large and turn on reduce motion.

prompt: A settings screen with a group of mutually exclusive sync-frequency options where selecting one automatically deselects the others.
goal: Select Hourly sync, then change the selection to Daily.

criteria.note: mutual exclusion: exactly one option active

prompt: A settings screen with a language picker offering four languages that updates a preview line beneath it.
goal: Change the language to French.

prompt: A two-level settings structure where a top-level row opens a sub-screen of related switches, and a summary on the parent row reflects how many are enabled.
goal: Open the Notifications sub-screen, enable exactly two of its four switches, and return to the parent screen.

prompt: A settings screen with a destructive 'delete account' action rendered distinctly from the others and requiring a typed confirmation word before it activates.
goal: Begin account deletion, type the confirmation word DELETE, and confirm.

prompt: A settings screen whose changes must survive navigating away to another screen and back.
goal: Enable the offline mode switch, navigate to the home screen, then return to settings.

prompt: A recipe search screen. Entering a query shows matching recipes with a result count; an empty result set shows a distinct empty state rather than a blank area.
goal: Search for 'zzzz' and confirm an explicit empty state appears, then search 'soup' and open the first result.

probes.why: silent blank areas are a portability failure a screenshot critic scores as fine

prompt: A document search with a submit-on-enter behaviour and a visible count of matches above the results.
goal: Search for 'budget'.

prompt: A search screen showing recent searches when the query box is empty, which are replaced by results once a query is entered.
goal: Search for 'atlas', then clear the box and confirm the recent searches reappear with 'atlas' among them.

prompt: A search screen with filter chips that refine an existing query, where the query and chips combine and the active chip is visually distinct.
goal: Search for 'report', then narrow the results with the PDF chip.

prompt: A search with a clear button inside the input that appears only when text is present and removes both the text and the results when pressed.
goal: Type 'delta', then use the inline clear button.

prompt: A search that is case and accent insensitive, so that querying 'cafe' matches an entry stored as 'Café'.
goal: Search for 'cafe' in lowercase and open the matching 'Café Rio' entry.

prompt: A search screen with a sort control that reorders results by relevance or by date without discarding the active query.
goal: Search for 'meeting' and switch the result ordering to date.

prompt: A search whose query must be preserved when opening a result and navigating back, so the user does not lose their place.
goal: Search for 'contract', open the second result, then return to the results list.

prompt: A search over a list of eight cities that matches on any part of the name, not only the start.
goal: Search for 'delhi' and open the result 'New Delhi'.

prompt: A search with a suggestion dropdown that appears while typing; choosing a suggestion fills the input and immediately runs the search.
goal: Type 'ban' and choose the 'bangalore' suggestion from the dropdown.

prompt: A search where clearing an active filter chip while a query is present must re-run the search rather than leaving stale results on screen.
goal: Search for 'invoice', apply the Unpaid chip, then remove the chip.

prompt: A search that rejects queries shorter than three characters with an inline hint rather than running an unhelpful search.
goal: Type 'ab', observe the hint, then extend the query to 'abc' and run the search.

prompt: A shipping form where choosing a country repopulates the region picker with that country's regions, and clears any previously chosen region.
goal: Choose Canada, select the region Ontario, then switch the country to India and select Karnataka.

prompt: A form where ticking a 'billing address differs' checkbox reveals a second address block that is hidden by default.
goal: Tick the checkbox and enter the billing city 'Surat' in the revealed block.

prompt: A product form where selecting a category filters the subcategory picker, and the subcategory control stays disabled until a category is chosen.
goal: Select the category Apparel and then the subcategory Footwear.

prompt: A three-level dependent picker for country, state, and city where changing the country clears both of the levels below it.
goal: Pick India, Kerala, and Kochi, then change the country to Canada and confirm both lower levels were cleared.

prompt: An order form where the quantity and unit price fields drive a computed total that updates as either changes.
goal: Set the quantity to 7 and the unit price to 30.

prompt: A payment form where choosing a payment method swaps in a different set of fields: card number and expiry for Card, or account and routing for Bank. Switching methods discards values from the previous method.
goal: Choose Card and enter the card number 4111111111111111, then switch to Bank and enter the account 00099911.

prompt: A form with an 'other' option in a dropdown that reveals a free-text field only when it is selected.
goal: Choose Other as the referral source and type 'conference talk' in the revealed field.

prompt: A form where a numeric field constrains the maximum of a second field, so lowering the first clamps the second down to the new ceiling.
goal: Set the seat limit to 10 and the invited count to 9, then lower the seat limit to 5.

prompt: A recurring reminder form where selecting a Weekly frequency reveals a day-of-week picker that is absent for Daily.
goal: Set the frequency to Weekly and choose Thursday.

prompt: A form where toggling a switch off makes a group of three related fields both hidden and excluded from validation, so the form can be submitted without them.
goal: Turn off the emergency contact switch and submit the form with only the name 'Arun' filled.

prompt: A form where two fields validate against each other bidirectionally, so correcting either one clears the shared error.
goal: Set the minimum to 80 and the maximum to 20 to trigger the shared error, then correct the minimum to 10.

prompt: A discount form where entering a valid promo code reveals a computed discount line and reduces the displayed total.
goal: Enter the promo code SAVE20 on an order subtotal of 200.

prompt: A photo grid where each tile has an overflow action offering Favourite and Delete. Deleting asks for confirmation in a dialog; cancelling leaves the item in place.
goal: Favourite the photo named 'sunset', then start deleting 'harbour' but cancel the confirmation.

prompt: A photo grid of six images where tapping a tile opens a full-screen viewer with a close control that returns to the grid.
goal: Open the photo 'bridge' and then close the viewer.

prompt: A gallery supporting multi-select mode entered by a long press, with a counter in the header and a bulk delete guarded by confirmation.
goal: Enter selection mode, select three photos, and delete them all, confirming when asked.

prompt: An audio list where each row has a play control, and starting one track stops any track already playing so that only one is active.
goal: Play the track 'Intro', then play 'Chorus'.

prompt: A media grid with an undo affordance shown briefly after a delete, which restores the removed item to its original position.
goal: Delete the photo 'canyon' and then undo the deletion.

prompt: A gallery where each item can be moved into one of three albums via a picker, and the source album count decreases as the destination increases.
goal: Move the photo 'reef' from Unsorted into the Travel album.

prompt: A photo detail screen with a caption field that saves on blur and shows the saved caption back on the grid tile.
goal: Open the photo 'meadow' and set its caption to 'Spring morning'.

prompt: A gallery with a favourites filter, where unfavouriting an item while the filter is active removes it from view immediately without disturbing scroll position.
goal: Turn on the favourites filter, then unfavourite the photo 'dunes'.

prompt: A video list where each row exposes a share action that opens a sheet listing three destinations, and choosing one records the share.
goal: Share the video 'Launch clip' to Email.

prompt: A photo viewer supporting next and previous navigation between items, where the controls are disabled at the first and last item respectively.
goal: Open the first photo and advance twice to reach the third.

prompt: A media grid with an empty state that appears once every item has been removed, offering an add-photos action.
goal: Delete all three photos, confirming each time.

prompt: A gallery where a rotate action on the detail screen changes the stored orientation and the change is reflected on the grid tile after returning.
goal: Open the photo 'tower' and rotate it once clockwise.

prompt: A gallery where a delete confirmation dialog can be dismissed by an outside tap or an escape gesture rather than an explicit cancel, and doing so must not remove the item.
goal: Begin deleting the photo 'orchard' and dismiss the dialog without pressing cancel or confirm.
